answer: Hardware remote attestation protects agent fleets hauling basalt and opal to a shipping wharf from Sybil attacks. Each agent runs inside a certified enclave that proves code integrity to peers using factory-fused signing keys. Forging identities requires an attacker to purchase genuine security chips, imposing a steep physical hardware cost per rogue node. However, this relies on centralized semiconductor vendors and cannot prevent side-channel memory leaks.
